facts.heading: WHERE IT BEGAN
facts.body: Netherlands led in 1700 with 3,377 international-$ (2011 prices) of gdp per capita - 11.9% of everything recorded that year.

facts.heading: UNITED KINGDOM TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: United Kingdom overtook Netherlands in 1808 at 3,250 international-$ (2011 prices).

facts.heading: AUSTRALIA TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: Australia overtook United Kingdom in 1853 at 4,798 international-$ (2011 prices).

facts.heading: UNITED KINGDOM TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: United Kingdom overtook Australia in 1856 at 5,013 international-$ (2011 prices).

facts.heading: THE RECORDED TOTAL
facts.body: Across the period the combined total went from 28,443 to 3.2 million international-$ (2011 prices) - about 113x.

facts.heading: NEW ZEALAND TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: New Zealand overtook United Kingdom in 1874 at 6,126 international-$ (2011 prices).

facts.heading: AUSTRALIA TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: Australia overtook New Zealand in 1877 at 6,433 international-$ (2011 prices).

facts.heading: UNITED STATES TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: United States overtook Australia in 1892 at 7,324 international-$ (2011 prices).
